```{r setup}
#| output: false

library(dplyr)
library(DT)
library(htmltools)
library(knitr)
library(leaflet)
library(readr)
library(scales)

source("R/fetch_ndbc_observations.R")
source("R/plot_ndbc_field.R")
source("R/plot_salinity_gauges.R")
source("R/load_field_data.R")

ndbc_data <- fetch_ndbc_hourly_snapshots(
  param = "sea_water_practical_salinity",
  value_col = "salinity"
)

salinity_data <- ndbc_data$latest |>
  filter(!is.na(salinity))

ref_date_label <- format(ndbc_data$reference_date, "%Y-%m-%d")
data_as_of_label <- format_ndbc_time(ndbc_data$data_as_of)
report_time <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z", tz = ndbc_display_tz)

n_stations <- nrow(salinity_data)
mean_salinity <- mean(salinity_data$salinity, na.rm = TRUE)
sal_range <- range(salinity_data$salinity, na.rm = TRUE)

salinity_fields <- interpolate_or_load_fields(
  ndbc_data$snapshots,
  value_col = "salinity"
)

salinity_palette <- c(
  "#2166ac", "#67a9cf", "#d1e5f0",
  "#fddbc7", "#ef8a62", "#b2182b"
)
```

::: {.content-visible when-format="dashboard"}
Data from [SECOORA ERDDAP](https://erddap.secoora.org/erddap/index.html) Everglades National Park buoys.
Interpolated fields use **DIVAnd** with bathymetry masking (methods from [south-florida-salinity](https://github.com/usf-imars/south-florida-salinity)).
**Report:** `r report_time` · **Latest data:** `r data_as_of_label` · **Reference day:** `r ref_date_label`
:::

## Row {height=65%}

```{r station-map}
#| title: Latest buoy readings
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7

if (nrow(salinity_data) == 0) {
  stop("No salinity data returned from ERDDAP for the current time window.")
}

pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = salinity_palette,
  domain = salinity_data$salinity,
  na.color = "#999999"
)

leaflet(salinity_data) |>
  addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") |>
  setView(
    lng = mean(salinity_data$longitude),
    lat = mean(salinity_data$latitude),
    zoom = 9
  ) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~longitude,
    lat = ~latitude,
    radius = 8,
    stroke = TRUE,
    weight = 1,
    color = "#333333",
    fillColor = ~pal(salinity),
    fillOpacity = 0.85,
    label = ~sprintf(
      "%s: %.1f PSU\n%s",
      location,
      salinity,
      format_ndbc_time(time)
    )
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = pal,
    values = salinity_data$salinity,
    title = "Salinity (PSU)",
    opacity = 0.9
  )
```

```{r station-table}
#| title: Station summary

salinity_data |>
  arrange(desc(time)) |>
  mutate(
    time = format_ndbc_time(time),
    salinity = number(salinity, accuracy = 0.1)
  ) |>
  select(
    Station = station,
    `Station ID` = station_id,
    Time = time,
    `Salinity (PSU)` = salinity
  ) |>
  datatable(
    rownames = FALSE,
    options = list(dom = "ft", pageLength = 10)
  )
```

## Row {height=35%}

::: {.card title="About this dashboard"}
This static dashboard combines **Leaflet** htmlwidgets ([Quarto interactivity docs](https://quarto.org/docs/interactive/widgets/htmlwidgets.html)) with **DIVAnd** variational interpolation and bathymetry-aware land masking from the south-florida-salinity project.

Lower salinity (blue) indicates fresher water; higher values (red) indicate more marine conditions. Practical salinity units (PSU) are parts per thousand.
:::

# Interpolated Field {scrolling="true"}

## Row

::: {.card title="Interpolation method"}
Fields use **DIVAnd** at ~0.01° resolution with a two-scale analysis (0.08° background + 0.035° local anomalies, `epsilon2 = 0.01`), run separately within each connected sea component. Land is masked with Natural Earth coastlines and NOAA BlueTopo 4 m bathymetry. Four panels show snapshots at **06:00, 12:00, 18:00, and 24:00 US Eastern** on `r ref_date_label`.
:::

## Row

```{r interpolated-map}
#| title: Hourly salinity fields
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10

if (all(vapply(
  salinity_fields,
  function(x) is.null(x$field) || nrow(x$field) == 0,
  logical(1)
))) {
  stop("No interpolated salinity fields were produced.")
}

plot_ndbc_field_panels(
  salinity_fields,
  value_col = "salinity",
  legend_title = "Salinity (PSU)",
  popup_suffix = " PSU",
  palette = salinity_palette,
  label_fn = format_hour_panel_label
)
```

# Gauges {scrolling="true"}

## Row

```{r gauge-summary}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: Low salinity
#| icon: arrow-down-circle
#| color: info
list(
  value = sum(salinity_data$salinity < SALINITY_LOW_THRESHOLD, na.rm = TRUE)
)
```

```{r gauge-summary-normal}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: Normal range
#| icon: check-circle
#| color: success
list(
  value = sum(
    !is.na(salinity_data$salinity) &
      salinity_data$salinity >= SALINITY_LOW_THRESHOLD &
      salinity_data$salinity <= SALINITY_HIGH_THRESHOLD
  )
)
```

```{r gauge-summary-high}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: High salinity
#| icon: arrow-up-circle
#| color: warning
list(
  value = sum(salinity_data$salinity > SALINITY_HIGH_THRESHOLD, na.rm = TRUE)
)
```
